function first(x: 'a' | 'b'): string {
  switch (x) {
    default:
      const unreachable: never = x;
      return unreachable;
    case 'a':
      return 'A';
    case 'b':
      return 'B';
  }
}

function middle(x: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  let log = '';
  switch (x) {
    case 'a':
      log += 'a;';
      break;
    default:
      const onlyC: 'c' = x;
      log += onlyC + ';';
    case 'b':
      const bOrC: 'b' | 'c' = x;
      log += 'then ' + bOrC + ';';
      break;
  }
  return log;
}

function fallsIntoDefault(x: 'a' | 'b' | 'c'): string {
  let log = '';
  switch (x) {
    case 'a':
      log += 'a;';
    default:
      const aOrC: 'a' | 'c' = x;
      log += aOrC + ';';
      break;
    case 'b':
      log += 'b;';
      break;
    case 'c':
      log += 'c;';
      break;
  }
  return log;
}

function conditions(x: string | number | boolean): string {
  switch (true) {
    default:
      const flag: boolean = x;
      return 'boolean ' + flag;
    case typeof x === 'string':
      return 'string ' + x.length;
    case typeof x === 'number':
      return 'number ' + x.toFixed(1);
  }
}

console.log(first('a'), first('b'));
console.log(middle('a'), middle('b'), middle('c'));
console.log(fallsIntoDefault('a'), fallsIntoDefault('b'), fallsIntoDefault('c'));
console.log(conditions('xy'), conditions(2), conditions(true));
